- flow (Q): portata
- velocity (v): velocità
- slope (S): pendenza

install.context: Volumetric flow rate. Appears in every calculator. Use the hydraulic/civil engineering term for discharge volume per unit time, not a general word for 'water flowing'.
install.translation_notes: Spanish has two common terms: 'caudal' (Spain, South America) and 'gasto' (Mexico). Lead with 'caudal'. Portuguese: 'vazão' (Brazil) or 'caudal' (Portugal) — lead with 'vazão'. Pre-2026 sr/hr human translations used 'protok/protoka' — consistent with current glossary entries (confirmed match). bg RESOLVED (Tom, 2026-07-13): native engineer's 2026-07-06 clarification confirmed both 'дебит' (colloquial/general register) and 'водно количество' (academic/hydraulic-engineering register, used at university for Q) are acceptable. Tom decided suite-wide standardization on 'водно количество' — "I would put водно количество everywhere" — applied across all bg calculator categories (pipes/irrigation included, not just the hydraulic-structure/open-channel strings the engineer originally corrected). 'дебит' fully replaced in lib/lang.ec.bg.php 2026-07-13. Task 109 stages 3-5 (2026-07-19): bg standardized on водно количество (дебит drift removed from or_/mpf_/cs_ per Bulgarian-engineer-feedback.md); sr standardized on проток (stage 4); it confirmed on portata (flusso drift removed).

install.context: Flow velocity (speed of water). Appears in all calculators.
install.translation_notes: Most languages use a direct cognate of 'velocity'. Do not use a word meaning 'speed' in a general sense if a more precise hydraulic term exists. Pre-2026 sr/hr human translations used 'tečenja' (= flowing, a verbal noun from 'teći' = to flow) — this is less precise than the current 'brzina/брзина' (= speed/velocity) and the current AI-generated term is preferred.

install.context: Dimensionless ratio of vertical drop to horizontal distance (rise/run). Used as channel slope (S_0) and friction slope in Manning and Darcy-Weisbach calculators. English aliases 'slope' and 'grade' (u_grade/u_gradePercent) both point here.
install.translation_notes: WMO No. 385 entry 477 ('energy gradient') confirms Russian: 'энергетический уклон' (energy slope) — the base term 'уклон' is WMO-verified. In open-channel hydraulics, 'slope' is the energy gradient — not a geometric angle. Use the civil engineering term for gradient/grade, not a geographic or topographic term. [2026-07-21] Centralized the grade activity-sense guard here (was living only as u_grade/u_gradePercent label commentary): the 'avoid' array now carries the running/walking/jogging exercise-incline trap, so the slope entry is the single home for the grade→energy-gradient concept and its wrong senses.

next_translated.value:
• Apri una qualsiasi pagina di calcolo.
  • Fai clic sull'icona di installazione (⊕ o icona a forma di computer) nella barra degli indirizzi del browser, oppure apri il menu del browser e scegli Installa EngCalcs…
  • Fai clic su Installa. EngCalcs si aprirà come app autonoma in una propria finestra.
next_translated.english:
• Open any calculator page.
  • Click the install icon (⊕ or computer icon) in the browser's address bar, or open the browser menu and choose Install EngCalcs…
  • Click Install. EngCalcs opens as a standalone app window.
